title: My Name Is Afghani
description: In “My Name Is Afghani,” by S.R., an EmpowerHer student, the writer tells the haunting story of a woman whose life has been shaped by war, widowhood, and generational loss. Through Afghani’s quiet endurance, the piece reflects the suffering of countless Afghan women while honoring their resilience, sacrifice, and struggle to survive in a world that offers them little mercy.
from: National Society of High School Scholars (NSHSS)
